title: The Stand-In
concept: According to the NSF award record, 2608510, the University of Alaska Fairbanks gets $1,772,170 over six years from August 1st, 2026 for GAIA, a plan led by Carl Tape for a digital twin that aims to estimate landslide hazards in close to real time. The award abstract describes a chain, rain soaks a slope, an earthquake weakens it, a later storm brings it down, and says the data that could warn of it come from separate systems that rarely work together. The plan adds fast surrogate models, stand-ins for slow physics, coupled to incoming observations. Haines (December 2020, KHNS) and Wrangell (November 2023, six killed) show the stakes. Nothing is built, the award record is the only public source, the University of Washington holds a larger partner award, and a loop only sharpens where instruments exist. A dashed ghost hill, the Stand-In, is the throughline and the film ends on an unlit socket beside one lit lamp.

fingerprint.palette: verdant wet moss-green slope layers, a muted sulphur-green storm key, slate timber, cool pale plates, a charcoal-cased pale-grey ghost and warm golden lantern light only on lit instruments
fingerprint.light_story: rain light that breaks to clear warm golden light on the instrumented slope
fingerprint.metaphor: a dashed ghost hill that redraws itself closer to a real slope each time a reading arrives, goes hollow when its feeds die, and fogs where no instrument listens

palette: verdant wet moss-green slope layers, a muted sulphur-green storm key, slate timber, cool pale plates, a charcoal-cased pale-grey ghost and warm golden lantern light only on lit instruments
divergence_note: The last five films were a sage-and-cream fiber chart desk (10-31), an aubergine dusk depot (10-29), a green-black sonar abyss (10-28), a sage civic hall (10-26) and a teal fog boardwalk (10-25). This film is overcast daylight on a wet layered hillside seen from a low angle, with slate timber props, grey-white plates, a standing relief map and a slate void. Its hero is a soaked slope with a goat and a dashed ghost hill, and it has no chart desk, no cream paper, no hall, no depot, no boardwalk and no sea cutaway. Gold appears only on listening instruments, and the signature object is a ghost hill that snaps closer to the real slope with each reading and fogs where no instrument listens.

treatment.title: The Stand-In
treatment.summary:
# TREATMENT (winner: Explainer "The Stand-In", hero LayeredLand slope with the Stand-In ghost)
Throughline: THE STAND-IN, a pale-grey dashed ghost hill. States: outline, grid, on the map, stale-grey beside the slumping slope, beside an unlit socket, tugged onto the slope, hollow with dead feeds, sharp near instruments and fog beyond, absent at Barry Arm, sharp beside one lit lamp.
Grafts: Dramatist hush frames for Haines and Wrangell, unlit-socket loop B, Enthusiast fair-case honesty, Comedian goat as skeptic. No prop bench, no blank tag.
Loop A: can a cartoon keep up with a real mountain, pla

angle.thesis: GAIA is a funded plan for a loop, not yet a forecaster: fast stand-in models redrawn every time new rain, ground-shaking, satellite or groundwater readings arrive, which is the only way to catch the rain, quake, later-storm chain that kills people on Alaska slopes, and it can only sharpen where instruments exist.
supporting_facts: c8 chain: rain soaks, quake weakens, later storm brings it down
c9 surrogate models couple to observations
c14 Wrangell six killed Nov 2023, c12/c13 Haines Dec 2020
angle.counterpoint: Nothing is built, the award record is the only public source, UW holds the larger partner award ($2,209,093), and agents are a planned prototype. A loop updates only where data exists.
angle.falsifiability: False if the record showed pilot results, a model running on a named Alaska slope, or a single-sensor or offline-simulation design.
runner_ups: Skeptic: held to funded-to-try, integration before prediction (merged as the Test act)
Enthusiast: Fairbanks as build end and ASF in the same town (grafted as the Alaska-advantage beat)
guardrails: plan language only: aims, plans, would
never say UAF leads the whole collaboration
no wave height for Barry Arm
paraphrase knowledge gaps as what scientists don't yet know
